# Third-party sources

This directory is a placeholder. scLAMP-SR does not vendor external method code.

- **MultiVI / totalVI**: install `scvi-tools` (see `requirements.txt`).
- **Cobolt**: `pip install cobolt`, or clone the official repository if you prefer a source install.
- **MIDAS**: clone the official source and pass `--midas-root`, or set `MIDAS_ROOT`.

Example:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/labomics/midas.git third_party/midas
```
